entities.summary: Anthony Peter Mayalla, also Anthony Petro Mayalla, was Tanzanian Catholic prelate who served as the Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Mwanza. He was appointed archbishop of Mwanza on 18 November 1987. He previously served as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Musoma between 1979 and 1987. He was appointed bishop on 12 January 1979 by Pope John Paul II. He died on 19 August 2009 aged 69 years.
